notes: מֵעַתָּה וְעַד־עוֹלָם divides as rule 26 directs: and to the waw, for to עַד, evermore to עוֹלָם; From to מִן and this time forth to עַתָּה, headed on time.
going out / coming in: each particle completes the motion lexeme of the infinitive (יָצָא go out, בּוֹא enter) rather than adding a direction the Hebrew does not write (rule 44).
